verdict.rationale: Circle's Agent Stack lets AI agents hold funds and transact autonomously within defined spending policies, trigger destination-chain actions after CCTP transfers, and react to state changes via webhooks — enabling background, autonomous agent-driven operations within Circle's payments domain. However, this is narrowly scoped to payment/transfer automation rather than a general-purpose automation/workflow scheduler, and there's no independent corroboration of these features working reliably in production. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader automation/scheduling engine beyond payments, and independent/hands-on validation of autonomous agent wallet behavior.
